strategy.summary: Hit the ducks to qualify Juggler Multiball, then loop the Hurricane ramp for 1M, 2M, and 5M. Cash Mystery and a prepared Comet million during the post-multiball playfield multiplier.

quickInfo.name: Juggler locks
quickInfo.summary: Duck targets light two locks; plunging the third ball starts the main multiball.

quickInfo.name: Hurricane ramp
quickInfo.summary: During multiball, repeated Hurricane ramps score the 1M, 2M, and 5M sequence.

quickInfo.name: Playfield multiplier
quickInfo.summary: Code chooses 2x, 3x, or 5x playfield scoring; active multiball time sets the window length, with a 15-second minimum, and Jackpot is excluded.

quickInfo.name: Comet
quickInfo.summary: Prepare the Comet million before the final ball drains, then collect it during the multiplier window.

quickInfo.name: Clown Time
quickInfo.summary: Complete the six clown-face elements and shoot the Hurricane ramp for the major-shot mode.

steps.text: Test the ducks, Juggler locks, Hurricane ramp, and Comet feed before choosing how aggressively to qualify multiball.
Complete the duck targets to light the first Juggler lock, then collect it.
Repeat for the second lock and plunge the third ball to begin multiball.
Repeat the Hurricane ramp for the 1M, 2M, and 5M sequence while preserving at least two controlled balls.

Before the final drain, use Ferris Wheel or the required progress to leave the Comet million ready. Skip this setup and start Multiball immediately when another Comet shot would risk the ball or the match needs only the ramp awards.
Keep multiball active to lengthen the later multiplier window; raised flippers pause its time accumulation but do not determine whether code awards 2x, 3x, or 5x.
After multiball ends, take lit Mystery, then collect the prepared Comet million while 2x, 3x, or 5x playfield scoring remains active.
Resume ducks and Juggler locks before pursuing lower-value face or bonus work.

fallback.title: Recovery: Palace and Comet scoring
fallback.when: Recovery pivot: Use this when duck rebounds or Juggler locks are unsafe but the Hurricane, Comet, or Ferris Wheel shots are repeatable.

steps.text: Use the repeatable Hurricane or Comet ramp to raise the Jackpot; Hurricane million shots also award Palace letters.
modeNotes: Read carried Palace, Clown, Jackpot, Comet, Mystery, and lock state before plunging; some progress persists between players or games.

steps.text: Use Ferris Wheel to relight Comet.
Collect the available Comet million without forcing Dummy targets.

alternatives.title: Position play: Clown Time
alternatives.when: When trailing, use this distinct scoreboard route: use this when the six face elements are nearly complete through incidental play.

steps.text: Shoot the Hurricane ramp to start Clown Time.
Repeat the safest lit major shot while its value grows.
Shoot Ferris Wheel to light the Comet million before multiball ends.
Keep multiball active to build a useful post-multiball timer.
Take lit Mystery, then collect Comet before the playfield multiplier expires.

techniques.name: Post-multiball Comet setup
techniques.instruction: Leave Comet lit before the last multiball drain, then make it the first controlled collect during the multiplier window.

techniques.name: Duration management
techniques.instruction: Keep balls moving safely because raised flippers pause accumulation of the later multiplier timer; multiball duration does not determine the 2x, 3x, or 5x factor.

cautions.issue: Duck and Dummy target rebounds can be more dangerous than the Hurricane, Comet, or Ferris Wheel shots.
cautions.response: Use multiball protection for target work and take Palace or Comet points when the rebounds are severe.

cautions.issue: Palace, Clown, and jackpot state may carry between players or games.
cautions.response: Read the inserts before plunging and do not assume a fresh qualification state.

strategy.simpleOverview: Hurricane qualifies Juggler Multiball through duck targets and two locks, then converts its duration into timed playfield scoring after the last ball drains. Prepare the Comet million, repeat the Hurricane ramp through 1M, 2M, and 5M, then collect Mystery and Comet during the post-Multiball multiplier.
strategy.overview: Hurricane qualifies Juggler Multiball through duck targets and two locks, then converts its duration into timed playfield scoring after the last ball drains. Prepare Comet only when safe, qualify two locks through the ducks, then repeat the Hurricane ramp while keeping multiple balls alive. Afterward, take Mystery and the prepared Comet before the multiplier expires.
